package studentruntime

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

type LocalBridge struct {
	Students studentuc.StudentUseCase
}

func (bridge LocalBridge) GetTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (*answeruc.TaskMetadata, error) {
	snapshot, err := bridge.Students.GetRuntimeTask(
		ctx,
		taskID,
		answeruc.TaskLookupUserIDFromContext(ctx),
		answeruc.TaskLookupAnswerIDFromContext(ctx),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return runtimeSnapshotToTaskMetadata(snapshot)
}

func (bridge LocalBridge) GetCourseStructure(context.Context, string) (*answeruc.CourseStructure, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (bridge LocalBridge) BindAnswer(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskID, answerID, sandboxID string, previewURL *string) error {
	var sandbox *domain.SandboxSession
	if sandboxID != "" {
		sandbox = &domain.SandboxSession{
			SandboxID:  sandboxID,
			PreviewURL: derefString(previewURL),
		}
	}
	_, err := bridge.Students.BindRuntimeAnswer(ctx, studentID, taskID, answerID, sandbox)
	return err
}

func (bridge LocalBridge) FinalizeAnswer(ctx context.Context, answerID string, passed bool, rawResult map[string]any, fileStorageID *string, sandboxID, previewURL *string) error {
	rawResultJSON, err := json.Marshal(rawResult)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return bridge.Students.FinalizeRuntimeAnswer(ctx, domain.RuntimeFinalizeInput{
		AnswerID:      answerID,
		Status:        statusNameFromPassed(passed),
		Passed:        passed,
		RawResult:     rawResultJSON,
		FileStorageID: fileStorageID,
		SandboxID:     sandboxID,
		PreviewURL:    previewURL,
	})
}

func runtimeSnapshotToTaskMetadata(snapshot *domain.RuntimeTaskSnapshot) (*answeruc.TaskMetadata, error) {
	if snapshot == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return &answeruc.TaskMetadata{
		ID:                     snapshot.ID,
		LessonID:               snapshot.LessonID,
		CourseID:               snapshot.CourseID,
		Title:                  snapshot.Title,
		Description:            snapshot.Description,
		LearningTargets:        append([]domain.LearningTargetRef(nil), snapshot.LearningTargets...),
		Status:                 snapshot.Status,
		Type:                   snapshot.Type,
		TaskKind:               snapshot.TaskKind,
		CodeStructureType:      snapshot.CodeStructureTypeCode,
		CodeStructure:          snapshot.CodeStructure,
		ComposeConfig:          snapshot.ComposeConfig,
		AllowedErrorsCount:     snapshot.AllowedErrorsCount,
		ExecutionMode:          snapshot.ExecutionMode,
		EvaluationMode:         snapshot.EvaluationMode,
		UIMode:                 snapshot.UIMode,
		SubmissionMode:         snapshot.SubmissionMode,
		RequiresSandbox:        snapshot.RequiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview:         snapshot.ExposesPreview,
		ExposesTerminal:        snapshot.ExposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: snapshot.SupportsLiveValidation,
		Completed:              snapshot.Access.Status == domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusPassed || snapshot.Access.Status == domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusSkipped,
		Readonly:               snapshot.Access.Status == domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusPassed || snapshot.Access.Status == domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusSkipped,
		Locked:                 snapshot.Access.Locked,
		Current:                snapshot.Access.Status == domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusAvailable || snapshot.Access.Status == domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusInProgress || snapshot.Access.Status == domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusFailed,
		BlockingReason:         snapshot.Access.BlockingReason,
		RedirectLessonID:       snapshot.Access.CurrentLessonID,
		RedirectTaskID:         snapshot.Access.CurrentTaskID,
		IsPracticeTaskRuntime:  true,
	}, nil
}

func statusNameFromPassed(passed bool) string {
	if passed {
		return "passed"
	}
	return "failed"
}

func derefString(value *string) string {
	if value == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return *value
}

func (bridge LocalBridge) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("studentruntime.LocalBridge(%p)", &bridge)
}
